title: Accessibility, i18n, time zones and language

questions.text: Which language does each input and output of this change have, and which field is its source (member setting, then org default, then Accept-Language, then product default)?
Does every new user-facing string have a key in every catalog? Do removed keys also have no code references?
Does anything detect language from text or audio? If so, is that only for labelling input, never for choosing output?
Does every speech-to-text, OCR or LLM call receive the language explicitly (language parameter, expected languages + threshold, system-prompt line)?
Is every time an instant, rendered in the member's IANA zone and computed at render or event time? Are dates without an instant stored floating?
Which error codes can reach the UI, and does each map to a localized sentence with a next step?
Is any locale, language name or 'respond in X' literal in code or prompts?
Which new colour pairs exist, and what are their WCAG ratios in light and dark?
Do I touch catalogs in a merge or rebase? Will I run the key-parity and merge-loss check afterwards?

budgets.measure: catalog parity script plus referenced-key extraction diff
axe color-contrast on built pages, light and dark
token ratio unit test for controls and focus rings

rules.title: Output language hardcoded in a prompt ('respond in English')
rules.why: Every member gets that language whatever their setting.
rules.confirm: failing-test: golden run in an org whose locale differs; output language is wrong
rules.fixHint: interpolate the resolved locale's name into the system prompt

rules.title: toLocaleString()/toLocaleDateString() with no locale or timeZone
rules.why: Renders in the host's zone and locale (UTC on servers), not the member's.
rules.confirm: failing-test: run under TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati and TZ=America/Sao_Paulo; outputs differ

rules.title: 'Today' computed from toISOString() (UTC date)
rules.why: Near midnight the UTC date is the member's yesterday or tomorrow.
rules.confirm: failing-test: freeze the clock at 23:30 in America/Sao_Paulo; assert the local date
rules.fixHint: format the instant in the member's IANA zone

rules.title: Locale catalog missing keys its sibling locales have
rules.why: Members see raw keys or another language; merges that took one side whole cause exactly this.
rules.confirm: static-proof: the flattened key sets differ
rules.fixHint: add the key to every locale in the same branch

rules.title: Language detected from text and used to choose output
rules.why: Language ID is unreliable on short strings (card titles, folder names).
rules.confirm: failing-test: English source content in a pt-BR org yields pt-BR output

rules.title: Error code or message string shown to members (toast(error.message))
rules.why: Members read SOME_CODE or a stack trace instead of a sentence and a next step.
rules.confirm: failing-test: force each error path; the DOM contains none of the enum's literal codes

rules.title: Speech-to-text call with no language or with 'auto' and no threshold
rules.why: Detection picks the wrong language and fluent text in a foreign script gets stored.
rules.confirm: failing-test: short noisy clip in the org's language; output script matches

verify.text: scan locale literals, prompt language literals, detection calls, date formatting without zone, colour literals
error-code exhaustiveness test + e2e DOM scan for raw codes
TZ matrix run (Kiritimati, Pago_Pago, Sao_Paulo) gives identical results; DST property tests
pseudo-locale run (en-XA) of key screens: no unaccented text
